facts.value: Online Bachelor of Arts in Business – Food Industry Management

Arizona State University’s Bachelor of Arts in business with a concentration in food industry management online prepares you for leadership roles in this ever-changing industry with a well-rounded foundation in business and a focus on the food sector.

This program pairs classwork in business management with specialized courses in food industry management. You’ll study topics such as business writing and organizational leadership, as well as concentrated courses in food retailing, advertising and more.

This online food industry management degree concentration was developed in partnership with successful industry leaders, ensuring the curriculum prepares you for leadership roles. Upon graduation, you’ll be equipped to apply for a wide variety of positions including, but not limited to:
Study at one of the best business schools in the nation
#2 best online bachelor's in business programs
#4 best online master’s in business programs (excluding MBA)
#4 best online general management MBA programs
#4 best online business analytics MBA programs
